title: Compatible Cohen power-series presentations of a complete local map
statement: Let $f:(A,\mathfrak m_A)\to(B,\mathfrak m_B)$ be a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], both complete for their maximal-ideal-adic topologies [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Then there are complete regular local rings $(R,\mathfrak m_R)$ and $(S,\mathfrak m_S)$, surjective local maps $q:R\to A$ and $v:S\to B$, and a local map $u:R\to S$ with $vu=fq$, such that $R$ and $S$ are formal power-series rings [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] over fields if $A/\mathfrak m_A$ has characteristic zero and over Cohen rings [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring] if it has characteristic $p>0$. One can choose a regular system of parameters $t_1,\ldots,t_d$ of $R$ whose images in $S$ extend to a regular system of parameters of $S$, with $t_1=p$ in residue characteristic $p$. The map $R\to S$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and $S/\mathfrak m_RS$ is regular local [def-weil-regular-scheme].
